Steaming milk

This page covers steaming milk: fresh beans, a steady grind and clean water matter most.

Weigh the coffee and the water so every brew can be repeated.

Taste, change one variable, and taste again before changing anything else.

FAQ

What milk steams best?

Whole milk is the easiest to texture.

How hot should milk get?

Stop at about 60 degrees.

Can I steam oat milk?

Yes, choose a barista blend.

Why does my milk scream?

The steam wand tip is too high.

Example Coffee Lab, brewing notes since 2019.
